chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) in the condemnation of the people of Iraq
[And in it he rebukes them for abandoning fighting, while victory is about to be achieved, then their denying him.]
ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Ali rebuke the people of Iraq in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) critiques the people of Iraq for their political opportunism, specifically their withdrawal from the Battle of Siffin when victory seemed assured, which led to the arbitration (Tahkim) and subsequent denial of his authority. This passage underscores the Shia scholarly view that their inconsistency stemmed not just from military hesitation but from a deeper spiritual and political fickleness that fractured the unity of the early Muslim community.
